description: This header file declares functions and structures related to managing server connections in the lighttpd server.

methods.name: connections_pool_clear
methods.description: Clears the connection pool for the server.

methods.name: connections_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with server connections.

methods.name: connection_graceful_shutdown_maint
methods.description: Performs a graceful shutdown maintenance on a connection.

methods.name: connection_periodic_maint
methods.description: Performs periodic maintenance tasks on a connection based on current timestamp.

methods.name: connection_accepted
methods.description: Handles accepting a new client connection on the server socket.

methods.name: connection_state_machine
methods.description: Advances the state machine for a given connection.
